## What problem does this solve?

Describe the defensive use case: what can you not do today that this would
enable?

## Proposed change

A clear description of the change, and — if it touches behaviour — what the
new output or exit codes would look like.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you evaluated, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Screenshots, references to advisories or detection research, example output.
